summary: Most of the frustration centres on learning curve and foundation gaps, followed by content order and difficulty mismatch and accessibility and technical issues. Lessons often introduce advanced topics before foundational concepts, leading to confusion and frustration for learners at all levels.

themes.name: Learning Curve and Foundation Gaps
themes.description: Users with gaps in foundational math skills struggle to keep up, leading to frustration and a sense of inadequacy.
themes.recommendation: Offer diagnostic assessments and adaptive learning paths to address individual gaps.

themes.name: Content Order and Difficulty Mismatch
themes.description: Lessons often introduce advanced topics before foundational concepts, leading to confusion and frustration for learners at all levels.
themes.recommendation: Reorganize content to follow a logical progression and align difficulty with learner readiness.

themes.description: Technical bugs, poor touch screen support, and accessibility issues (e.g., KaTeX rendering, screen reader compatibility) hinder user experience.

themes.name: Engagement and Motivation
themes.description: Some users find the platform repetitive or unengaging, especially when compared to more interactive or gamified alternatives.
themes.recommendation: Enhance gamification elements and provide more interactive content to boost engagement.
